propositions: A runaway read_file loop correctly triggers the runaway guard, which aborts the evidence search and truncates the criterion evaluation, but this truncation is incorrectly reported as a blocking exit-1 FAIL instead of a retryable exit-11 INDETERMINATE fault.

In _restamp_marker, a met=false record for a criterion never banked (entry is None) loses the evidence_sufficient=False marker and is stamped bare, becoming indistinguishable from a genuine refutation.

reconcile_verdict derives evidence_sufficient=False for insufficiency-only failures but does not set verdict_obtainable=False, so close_precheck and verify-completion never route insufficiency through the retryable exit-11 path.

The fix marks unbanked (truncated) met=false echoes with evidence_sufficient=False in _restamp_marker and routes all FAILs through a shared completion_fail_returncode helper that returns exit 11 when evidence_sufficient is False or verdict_obtainable is False.
Genuine refutations (conclusive bank entry with no insufficiency marker) remain bare met=false and still dispose as exit 1, preserving the hard block for actual failures.
The no-criterion fault (verdict_obtainable=False, bug 2a6f) continues to dispose as exit 11 unchanged; the evidence_sufficient marker is reused and routed through the shared disposition logic.
